About the event
Sharpen Your Skills in One Focused Session

The Golf Skills Clinic is a hands-on session designed to help golfers of every level tighten up their fundamentals. From swing mechanics to short game precision, our coaches walk you through focused drills you can take straight to the course.

Whether you're working on consistency off the tee or finally looking to fix that slice, this clinic gives you direct, personalized feedback in a relaxed, supportive setting.
